roundingRule: Monthly values are calculated in full precision; displayed totals use Math.round to KRW.
formula: payment=P*r*(1+r)^n/((1+r)^n-1); interest=sum(balance*r); r=annualRate/12.
source: Independent amortization formula cross-check; common banking annuity repayment formula.
crossCheckedWith: Independent spreadsheet-style amortization calculation.

roundingRule: Monthly values are calculated in full precision; displayed totals use Math.round to KRW.

crossCheckedWith: Independent spreadsheet-style amortization calculation.

roundingRule: Displayed KRW values use Math.round after calculation.
formula: discount=price*rate/100; after=price-discount; vat=after*0.1; final=after+vat.

roundingRule: Input gross amount is divided by 1.1 before discount; displayed KRW values use Math.round.
formula: base=gross/1.1; after=base-discount; vat=after*0.1; final=after+vat.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Add operation excludes start date and counts only arrived business days.
formula: Move one calendar day at a time; skip weekends and holidays; stop when business-day counter reaches N.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Add operation excludes start date and counts only arrived business days.

roundingRule: Exact integer match. Between operation excludes start date and includes end date.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Add operation excludes the start date; pre-effective-date May 1 remains a business day.
formula: Labor Day enters the public-holiday rule only for year>=2026; therefore 2025-05-01 is counted.
effectiveFrom: Boundary before the 2026-05-01 Labor Day public-holiday provision effective date
crossCheckedWith: Independent 2025 calendar count and the provision's stated effective date.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Add operation excludes the start date; pre-effective-date July 17 remains a business day.

effectiveFrom: Boundary before the 2026-05-11 Constitution Day/national-holiday provision effective date

roundingRule: Exact date match. The start date is excluded; May 6 is skipped once as the single substitute holiday.
formula: Group holidays by original date before substitution; Children's Day and Buddha's Birthday overlap on 2025-05-05 and produce one substitute day on 2025-05-06.
effectiveFrom: 2025 calendar boundary: one substitute holiday on 2025-05-06 for the same-date overlap
crossCheckedWith: Independent 2025 calendar count; the next business day after the substitute holiday is 2025-05-07.

roundingRule: Exact date match. The start date is excluded and May 7 must be counted as a business day.
formula: A same-date overlap creates only one substitute holiday; do not create a second substitute day on 2025-05-07.
effectiveFrom: 2025 calendar boundary: 2025-05-07 remains a business day
crossCheckedWith: Independent 2025 calendar count after the single substitute holiday on May 6.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Weekend days are skipped before holiday matching; Monday June 8 remains a business day.
formula: Memorial Day is a fixed public holiday but is not in the substitute-holiday eligibility list.
crossCheckedWith: Independent 2026 calendar count; no substitute holiday is generated for Memorial Day.

roundingRule: Exact date match. October 1 is skipped once as a government-designated temporary holiday.

roundingRule: Exact date match. Skip the weekend, January 27 temporary holiday, and the three-day Lunar New Year holiday.

roundingRule: Exact date match. June 3 is skipped once as the government-designated presidential election holiday.

roundingRule: Educational estimate. Displayed age uses Math.round.

crossCheckedWith: Independent arithmetic using the documented project model.

roundingRule: Use complete 131m distance ticks after the 1.6km base distance, then round the estimated metered fare to the nearest KRW 10.
crossCheckedWith: Independent tick arithmetic against the Seoul Metropolitan Government tariff table.

roundingRule: Use the published 23:00-02:00 base and 131m distance tick values, then round the estimated metered fare to the nearest KRW 10.
crossCheckedWith: Independent peak-night tick arithmetic against the Seoul Metropolitan Government tariff table.

roundingRule: Subtract the base-distance-equivalent time, count only complete 30-second ticks, then round the estimated fare to the nearest KRW 10.
formula: 4800 + floor((600 - 1600/(15.72/3.6))/30)*100 = 5500; no distance tick is added at exactly 1.6km.
crossCheckedWith: Independent low-speed tick arithmetic against the page's documented aggregate-time approximation.

roundingRule: Apply the documented combined 60% maximum to the daytime meter estimate and round to the nearest KRW 10.
formula: Day meter=11200; combined night 40% + out-of-city 20%=60%; 11200*1.60=17920.
crossCheckedWith: Independent combined-surcharge arithmetic against the Seoul Metropolitan Government maximum-surcharge table.

roundingRule: No fare is produced for invalid inputs; the page clears result panels.

crossCheckedWith: Static page validation and a direct calculator boundary test.

roundingRule: Displayed GPA is rounded to two decimal places with Number.toFixed(2).

source: Project-documented example grade table; users must compare it with their institution's policy.
crossCheckedWith: Independent weighted-average arithmetic against the Korean and English page tables.

roundingRule: Displayed GPA is rounded to two decimals; credit totals retain their half-credit precision.
formula: P earns 3 credits but is excluded from GPA; F contributes 3 GPA credits at zero and earns none; A0 contributes 3 credits at 4.0, so GPA=12/6=2.00 and earned credits=6.
source: Project-documented P/F contract; institutional policies can differ.
crossCheckedWith: Independent P/F weighted-average arithmetic against the Korean and English page behavior.

roundingRule: Double the entered one-way distance first; fuel is shown to one decimal and each KRW result uses Math.round.
